story.title: A scent can change the entire room.
story.text: We believe Bukhoor is more than fragrance. It is welcome, calm, celebration and memory — carried in smoke.
story.note: Made for quiet mornings, generous welcomes and evenings that linger.

ritual.title: Three simple steps.
ritual.text: Place a small piece of Bukhoor over safely prepared charcoal or an electric burner, let the fragrance bloom, then allow the smoke to move gently through your space.
ritual.safety: Always use a heat-safe burner on a stable surface and never leave burning charcoal unattended.
